faq_section_question_1: Which exams does EasyPrüfung currently support?
faq_section_answer_1: EasyPrüfung currently supports TELC Deutsch B1, including Leseverstehen, Sprachbausteine, Hörverstehen, and Schriftlicher Ausdruck. Additional TELC and Goethe exams from A1 to C2 are planned.
faq_section_question_3: How does the AI help me prepare?
faq_section_answer_3: AI generates level-appropriate exercises, evaluates written answers, calculates scores, and provides personalized feedback and explanations so you can understand mistakes and improve.
faq_section_question_4: Is EasyPrüfung affiliated with TELC or the Goethe-Institut?
faq_section_answer_4: No. EasyPrüfung is an independent preparation platform and is not affiliated with or endorsed by telc gGmbH or the Goethe-Institut.
faq_section_question_2: How realistic is the mock-exam experience?
faq_section_answer_2: The digital practice interface closely recreates the structure, layout, navigation, question types, answer formats, and timed experience of a TELC digital exam so you can become familiar with the workflow before exam day.
